provider: OVHcloud Object Storage One-Zone Standard (Poland subsidiary) — flat S3 with contractually free egress

free_tier.stated: Unlimited / unbilled minimum: «Możesz przechowywać dowolną ilość danych, nie określamy minimalnego wolumenu». Billed per GiB-hour at 0.00004861 PLN, shown as ~0.0354853 PLN/GiB/month over 730 h.

egress.terms: FREE, three times over and verbatim: the prices table reads «Ruch zewnętrzny przychodzący/wychodzący | Darmowy» (external incoming/outgoing traffic: free) for Standard, High Performance AND Infrequent Access; the product page states «nie płacisz za wywołania API ani za ruch przychodzący i wychodzący» (no charge for API calls nor for incoming or outgoing traffic); the classes page repeats «Brak opłat za ruch wychodzący». API requests and data retrieval also «Darmowy».

tooling: rclone `s3` (any S3 client), s3cmd, aws-cli, boto3, restic/borg via rclone. Live endpoints probed: s3.waw.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307, s3.gra.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307, s3.rbx.io.cloud.ovh.net -> 307 (all answer with an S3 XML 307 to the product page, i.e. the clusters are up and addressing buckets by region).
chaining: Unbounded — a bucket has no plan size, so 10 TiB and 20 TiB are the same product at the same rate. No tier break at all until the 3-AZ Standard 50 TiB step.
limits_note: Infrequent Access adds a 30-day minimum storage duration and 0.01728 PLN/GiB retrieval, so the cheap IA rate is a trap if you read back early. Currency/billing is via the PL subsidiary in PLN; OVH requires a card and an account with a billing country it accepts.
reliability_note: No reliability concern raised by any source; OVH is a tier-1 European operator with its own AS and datacentres, ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701 on the product page. The only real question is One-Zone regional availability — Warsaw is a 3-AZ region for Object Storage on current OVH docs, and the PLN sheet prices One-Zone and Local Zone generically. Confirm the region at order time; the 3-AZ Standard rate is 1.72× higher.

price_per_tb_month: One-Zone Standard: $9.34/TB/mo ($112.03/TB/yr) with free egress, free API calls, free retrieval — identical at 5 TB and 20 TB because pricing is strictly per-GiB with no tiers. One-Zone Infrequent Access: $4.55/TB/mo storage but +$2.27/TB per full read-back (0.01728 PLN/GiB) and a 30-day minimum…

extras.price_verbatim: One-Zone Standard: $9.34/TB/mo ($112.03/TB/yr) with free egress, free API calls, free retrieval — identical at 5 TB and 20 TB because pricing is strictly per-GiB with no tiers. One-Zone Infrequent Access: $4.55/TB/mo storage but +$2.27/TB per full read-back (0.01728 PLN/GiB) and a 30-day minimum, so $6.82/TB/mo effective on one read = $81.83/TB/yr. 3-AZ Standard: $16.07/TB/mo, first 50 TiB. Swift Standard: $12.68/TB/mo. All PLN converted at 0.256916 USD/PLN and 1024 GiB/TB.
